subject: Letter received from Inland Revenue Department for Tai Hang Design Studio Limited
body:
Dear Mr Jason Lam,

We have received an Employer's Return of Remuneration and Pensions (BIR56A) for the year ended 31 March 2026 from the Inland Revenue Department for Tai Hang Design Studio Limited. The return (BIR56A) and employee notifications (IR56B) must be completed and filed by 21 November 2026.

A scan of the letter is attached for your reference. Please let us know if you would like our assistance in preparing and filing the return.

Best regards,
XYZ CPA
